name: McLaughlin Eastshore SP SS
description: McLaughlin Eastshore State Park stretches along 8.5 miles of San Francisco Bay shoreline from Richmond to Oakland, including tidal marshes and mudflats such as the Emeryville Crescent, Albany Mudflat, and Hoffman Marsh. It is operated by the East Bay Regional Park District.
fullDescription: McLaughlin Eastshore State Park stretches along 8.5 miles of San Francisco Bay shoreline from Richmond to Oakland, including tidal marshes and mudflats such as the Emeryville Crescent, Albany Mudflat, and Hoffman Marsh. It is operated by the East Bay Regional Park District.
whatTheyOffer:
- Walking and biking on the San Francisco Bay Trail
- Bird watching and wildlife viewing
- Fishing, beach areas, and windsurfing
- Parking and restrooms in developed areas; no camping
howToGetIt: No day-use fee is listed. Operated by the East Bay Regional Park District; call 510-562-7275 or visit ebparks.org for access points and parking. Some areas of the park are still being planned and developed.
